headline: Iran Launches Massive UAV Strike on Kurdistan as IDF Kills Hamas Leaders
subheadline: IDF intercepted two UAVs near the Jordan border while eliminating senior terrorists Amr Abu al-Rish and Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in Gaza.
lede: IDF intercepted two UAVs near the Jordan border (launch source under investigation) and killed senior Hamas figures Amr Abu al-Rish in southern Gaza and Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in northern Gaza while the Northern Brigade and Yahalom destroyed a Hamas underground tunnel hundreds of meters long in northern Gaza. Iran launched a large-scale UAV attack on Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan in the Kurdistan Region, with jets and C-RAM systems intercepting the drones, and the Iranian Health Minister reported 60 killed and 670 injured from recent US strikes on southern Iran over the past 10‑12 days. The Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil transfer centers en route to Yanbu, and Saudi air defenses intercepted drones that originated from Iraqi airspace.

sections.title: Russian Gains and Ukrainian Drone Strikes
sections.body: Russian forces reported the liberation of Torskoye in the Donetsk People's Republic and Kommunarovka in the Dnepropetrovsk region. Russia increased its military strength by 27,000 personnel, bringing the total to 2.426 million. A massive drone attack involving over 350 drones targeted Russian regions, killing two civilians in Rostov-on-Don, while Russian forces struck a fuel storage complex in the port of Odessa and a bulk carrier in the port of Nikolaev. Ukrainian forces are employing long-range drones to target Russian economic infrastructure and oil production, and the Ukrainian 301st air defense regiment is being transferred from Nikopol to the Kharkov direction.

sections.title: Iranian UAV Assault and IDF Operations
sections.body: The IDF intercepted two UAVs near the Jordan border (launch source under investigation) and killed senior Hamas figures Amr Abu al-Rish in southern Gaza and Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in northern Gaza. Iran launched a large-scale UAV attack on Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan in the Kurdistan Region, with jets and C-RAM systems intercepting the drones. The Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil transfer centers en route to Yanbu, and Saudi air defenses intercepted drones that originated from Iraqi airspace, while the Iranian Health Minister reported 60 killed and 670 injured from recent US strikes on southern Iran over the past 10‑12 days.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iranian UAV strikes on the Kurdistan Region, Houthi drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure intercepted over Iraqi airspace, and IDF targeted killings and tunnel destruction in Gaza show simultaneous activity across multiple fronts. The reported US strikes on southern Iran causing 60 deaths and 670 injuries, coupled with the Khatam al-Anbiya threat of retaliation against a naval blockade, heighten the risk of direct US‑Iran escalation amid converging proxy activity in Iraq, Yemen, Lebanon and Israeli operations in Gaza and the West Bank.
